manifiesto.title: "To me, the most important thing is being a good human being and speaking the truth."
paragraphs: I started in foreign trade more than ten years ago, seeing the constant frustration of business owners losing capital to unscrupulous middlemen: samples that didn't match mass production, made-up customs surcharges, and phantom factories that disappeared after the deposit.

At KM Business Consulting we built our practice on one radical premise: working with absolute transparency. If a supplier doesn't meet quality standards or a route isn't right for your budget, we tell you upfront. We're not looking to rush a deal — we're building a long-term partnership that protects your peace of mind.
manifiesto.whatsappMessage: Hi Kattya, I read your manifesto on the website and I'd like to talk about an import.

principios.title: Our four non-negotiable principles
principios.lead: The foundation of how we operate and handle our clients' money and goods.

items.title: 1. Integrity and technical truth
items.description: No false promises of impossible timelines or misleading quotes. Truthful information and formal contracts from day one.

items.title: 2. Direct control at origin
items.description: We don't triangulate through unknown third parties. We have our own inspectors in China who walk the plants and check the packaging.

items.title: 3. Cost efficiency
items.description: Open-book cost structures where you know exactly the factory value, freight, and tariffs.

items.title: 4. Lifelong relationships
items.description: We take pride in seeing our clients grow and keep importing with us year after year, as business partners.
